annotation.interpretation_a: Endpoints that can close the UDP socket may use an abbreviated draining period.
annotation.interpretation_b: Endpoints that have other means to prevent late packets from creating state may also use an abbreviated draining period.
annotation.justification: The clause does not define 'alternative means', leaving it open to interpretation whether only closing the UDP socket qualifies or other mechanisms also qualify, which materially changes implementation behaviour.
annotation.missing_information: Definition of what constitutes 'alternative means' that ensures no QUIC state is created by late-arriving packets. This missing constraint leads to different implementation behaviours regarding when an abbreviated draining period can be used.
